x: Their win was an impressive one, and their scoring three—Harold Whitlock (1), Rex Whitlock (3) and Fred Redman (11)—well deserved their gold Championship medals, and the honour of winning the first Senior Championship for their club.
Surprise of the race was the excellent performance of Lloyd Johnson who finished 2nd to Rex Whitlock and gave the Olympic Selectors something to think about.
Thirteen teams comprising 97 walkers lined up for the start of a three-lap course, and immediately Rex Whitlock, Don Tunbridge and Proctor went to the front and set the pace.
